title: CoinRabbit begins operating
description: CoinRabbit began operating as a crypto-backed lending platform in 2020.
notes: The exact launch day was not identified; 1 January is a sortable approximate date based on current first-party company and product pages.

title: CoinRabbit launches its crypto savings account
description: CoinRabbit announced a newly launched crypto savings account backed by its crypto-loan business, with daily account updates and flexible withdrawal conditions.
notes: Historical rates and supported assets are recorded as launch context, not current guaranteed terms.

title: CoinRabbit launches mobile app
description: CoinRabbit launched a mobile app combining loan management, swaps, storage, and portfolio tools.
notes: App-launch milestone for the continuing platform.

title: CoinRabbit terms define current Earn and collateral ownership structure
description: CoinRabbit's updated terms defined the Earn Interest Product, daily accrual and withdrawal mechanics, and contractual ownership transfer for topped-up Earn assets and loan collateral.
notes: Contractual event used to preserve ownership and use terms; it is not a customer-loss event.

title: CoinRabbit remains active across loans and Earn
description: Current first-party pages described active fixed and open-ended loans and an Earn product with daily accrual and flexible withdrawals.
notes: Current-state snapshot; rates, assets, limits, verification, reserve practices, and availability can change.

title: Nebeus begins operating as a crypto-lending platform
description: Nebeus was founded in 2014 and developed from a crypto-lending platform into a broader financial app.
notes: The exact launch day was not identified; 1 January is a sortable approximate date.

title: Nebeus documents active crypto Renting programs
description: Nebeus publicly described multiple crypto Renting and staking options, including fixed-term programs with different assets, lockups, and rewards.
notes: This is the earliest precisely dated reviewed source for the Renting product family, not necessarily the original launch date.

title: Nebeus updates Renting ownership and operational terms
description: Updated Nebeus Renting Terms stated that users retain legal ownership while assets are locked, operationally controlled, and potentially deployed through Nebeus infrastructure and authorised providers.
notes: The current ownership model differs materially from older first-party lease and rehypothecation language, so both versions are linked.

title: Nebeus remains active across loans and Renting
description: Current first-party materials described continuing crypto-backed loans and multiple flexible or fixed Renting programs with daily rewards and program-specific lockups.
notes: Current-state snapshot; exact reward rates, plans, contracting entity, assets, custody providers, and jurisdictional access can change.
